title: Orthogonality of Hermite coefficients
statement: For any dimension $n$ and multi-indices $\alpha,\beta\in\mathbb N^n$, the Hermite coefficient of the Hermite function $H_\alpha$ at $\beta$ is $1$ if $\alpha=\beta$ and $0$ otherwise.
